jobs.title: Senior Software-Testingenieur:in
jobs.description:
Für einen unseren Key Accounts, ein internationale angesehenes Unternehmen aus der maritimen Branche, suchen wir aktuell einen: Senior QA Engineer (m/w/d) – Fokus Integration Testing & Test Automation - Gehalt bis 85.000€ (bei herausragendem Match höher)

Die Person wird die Qualität unserer Systemintegrationen, Datenmigrationen sowie Geschäftsprozesse sicherstellen. In dieser Position arbeitest du eng mit Testmanagement, Projekt- und Entwicklungsteams zusammen und trägst maßgeblich zur Stabilität und Zukunftsfähigkeit unserer IT-Infrastruktur bei.

Deine Aufgabenbereiche:

Testplanung und Durchführung für Systemintegrationen, Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse und End-to-End-Prozesse
(Integrations-, System-, Regression- und Smoke-Tests)
Fehleranalyse, Reproduktion, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung

Qualitätssicherung bei Datenmigrationen, inklusive Validierung von Datenmapping, Transformationen und Abgleichen

Aufbau und Optimierung automatisierter Tests (API-, UI-, Regressionstests)

Entwicklung bestehender Testframeworks, bevorzugt mit Cypress

Einbindung automatisierter Tests in CI/CD-Pipelines

Erstellung und Verwaltung von Testfällen und Testdaten in JIRA sowie Xray

Kollaboration mit Testmanagement, internen Fachbereichen, Entwicklung und externen Partnern

Optimierung von QA-Prozessen, Standards und Best Practices, inklusive Unterstützung internationaler QA-Teams

Anforderungen:

Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder ähnliche Qualifikation

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Software- oder Integrationstests
innerhalb komplexer Systemumgebungen
Umfassende Kenntnisse im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Testautomatisierung

Erfahrung im Testen von Systemintegrationen und Schnittstellen
(APIs, datenbasierte Integrationen)
Umgang mit Testmanagement-Tools wie JIRA und Xray

Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierungs-Tools, vorzugsweise Cypress

Kenntnisse in CI/CD-Prozessen
und automatisierten Testdurchläufen
Erfahrung mit Datenmigrationen und Datenvalidierung

Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen (kein must have):

Erfahrung mit Integrationsplattformen, idealerweise Microsoft Azure Logic Apps

Kenntnisse im API-Testing und Integrationsszenarien

Erfahrung in Transformationsprojekten oder Systemeinführungen (ERP- oder SaaS-Systeme, z. B. Workday)

Erfahrung im Coaching von QA-Mitarbeitenden

Unser Angebot:

Eine zentrale Rolle in strategischen IT-Transformationsprojekten

Mitgestaltung von Testautomatisierung und QA-Prozessen
auf nachhaltiger Ebene
Langfristige Perspektive und Entwicklungspotenzial im Bereich Integration und Qualitätssicherung

Internationales Arbeitsumfeld

Moderne Struktur mit flachen Hierarchien

Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten mit Eigenverantwortung

Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Exklusive Location am Wasser mit internem Fitnessbereich/SPA und Restaurant

Attraktives Vergütungspaket inkl. finanzieller Sicherheit, Mobilitätsleistungen und weiteren Vorteilen !

Falls Dich die Stellenbeschreibung angesprochen hat, freuen wir uns über Deine Bewerbung.

Gespräche werden ab sofort geführt.

jobs.title: AI-Native Full-Stack / Backend Engineer (Forward Deployed Engineering)
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.
🟢

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend - Fintech Platform (m/f/n)
jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost's FinTech Platform team is looking for a Staff Engineer to define the technical direction for one of our platform areas - Payments Core, Merchant, or Consumer. You'll multiply team output through architecture clarity, engineering standards, and cross-team technical leadership, while helping evolve our agentic engineering harness in a data-driven way.

You'll own the evolution of fundamental technology decisions across your area - ensuring they're sound, defensible, and viable for the long term - and act as the technical throughline between engineering teams, product strategy, and the organisation's wider architecture standards.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Define and maintain the backend technical architecture for your area: domain boundaries, event contracts, state machine patterns, data consistency models, and cross-service API design across multiple teams
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs, facilitating technical decision-making across teams with documented reasoning and clear trade-off analysis
Evaluate and decide on fundamental technology trade-offs: database selection, cloud services, message broker topology, and consistency models appropriate for financial data
Own the evolution of the agentic development harness - instrument it, measure adoption and friction, and drive improvements with data
Drive org-wide technical change: identify patterns to adopt or deprecate broadly, build the case, and see adoption through across teams without direct authority
Provide technical input into product strategy; mentor Staff-track engineers through design reviews, pairing, and technical writing feedback

Qualifications

8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
3+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
Hands-on experience with multiple tech stacks and expertise in backend
Solid grounding in distributed systems architecture - event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern - and state machine / financial entity lifecycle design
Experience designing APIs at service-boundary level - REST, async, and event-based contracts
Comfort with database trade-off reasoning (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Experience designing or evolving an agentic engineering harness — instrumentation, adoption measurement, iteration
Working knowledge of LLM tool-use patterns and context management in engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing - ADRs, RFCs, and design docs for multiple audiences
English proficiency at B2 or above

Nice to have:

2+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
2+ years in BNPL or lending domain architecture
PCI DSS / PSD2 architecture compliance experience from the design phase
Kafka or equivalent streaming architecture experience at scale
Open-source contributions or technical publishing
Polish language skills

Additional Information

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
 InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and flexible hours
We offer B2B type of contract

Developing applications using Power Platform components, such as Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Virtual Agents and integrate them into Microsoft and Azure ecosystems.
Developing integrations & plugins using .NET framework (C#).
Supporting team of Microsoft Dynamics 365, analysts in complex solutions delivery: participation on functional requirements gathering, functionality outlining, testing and deployments.
Getting a deep technology understanding Power Apps products & knowledge about possibilities of customizations, configurations, limitations, and constraints. 
Working with Power Apps Model driven, Canvas and Dataverse
Configure Power Apps

YOUR PROFILE

Experienced professional (8+ years) with 3+ years of experience in Power Platform
Technical Skills:
Experience with Power Platform
Hands on Experience in Canvas App development
Experience with Power Automate
Experience with PCF control and Plugins
Familiar with Azure Cloud Component
MS Dynamics 365 (Development) experience
Nice to have C# experience
Nice to have JavaScript / Typescript, HTML, CSS experience

Technical awareness:
Application structures
Performance
Security
Power BI components
Adjusting configurations
Functional and technical mindset

Mindset/attitude:
Self-starter
Ownership
Speak-up
Creative thinker
Pragmatic

FREQUENTLY USED TECHNOLOGIES:

Microsoft Power Platform
MSD365 Dynamics
Azure or any other Cloud Infrastructure

What You’ll Love About Working Here

Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details.
Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Architects, Google) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform,  Pluralsight, TED Talks, Coursera and Udemy Business materials and trainings. 
Practical benefits: private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and 40+ options on our NAIS benefit platform, including Netflix, Spotify or Multisport.

GET TO KNOW US

Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued.

Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.
